usedFor: Training teams use Certifier to hand out certificates with “Issue Credential” and watch for a “New Group”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Group” in Certifier, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: When a certificate group is created, a file can be shared straight away.

watchOut: “Issue Credential” creates, issues and sends a credential to a recipient, so it waits for your approval.
